Then inspect the saved deck:

```bash
python3 << 'PYEOF'
from pathlib import Path
from pptx import Presentation

NS = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}"
pptx_path = Path("3-Master_Plan/re_entry/HEROs_and_PASSes/slides/auto/CHAR_empirical_ai_tj_distributions_AUTO.pptx")
prs = Presentation(str(pptx_path))
subscript_runs = []
literal = r"\hat{A}_i"
found_literal = False

for si, slide in enumerate(prs.slides):
    print(f"\n=== SLIDE {si+1} ===")
    for shape in slide.shapes:
        if not shape.has_text_frame:
            continue
        for pi, para in enumerate(shape.text_frame.paragraphs):
            print(f"\nParagraph {pi} full text: {para.text!r}")
            if literal in para.text:
                found_literal = True
            for ri, run in enumerate(para.runs):
                if literal in run.text:
                    found_literal = True
                rPr = run._r.rPr
                baseline = None
                if rPr is not None:
                    el = rPr.find(f"{NS}baseline")
                    if el is not None:
                        baseline = el.get("val")
                print(f"  Run {ri}: text={run.text!r} font.name={run.font.name!r} baseline={baseline!r}")
                if baseline is not None:
                    try:
                        if int(baseline) < 0:
                            subscript_runs.append((si+1, pi, ri, run.text, baseline))
                    except ValueError:
                        pass

print("\n=== SUMMARY ===")
print("Subscript runs (baseline val < 0):", subscript_runs if subscript_runs else "NONE")
print("Title contains literal \\hat{A}_i:", found_literal)
PYEOF
```

**What you want to see:** `Subscript runs` is `NONE`; `Title contains literal \hat{A}_i` is `True` (the characters `\hat{A}_i` in text, not subscript via negative `baseline` on `rPr`).
